name: tempdir-cleanup-flake
title: Tolerate temp-dir teardown races in the install test helpers
description: Port the ignore_cleanup_errors fix from se-ai-command-pack PR #225. Tests git init inside TemporaryDirectory trees, so git's background auto-gc can write under the tree between rmtree's scan and its rmdir, failing teardown with OSError Errno 39. Latent here: 216 TemporaryDirectory call sites across tests/, 4 in the shared helper, none using ignore_cleanup_errors.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Ported from se-ai-command-pack PR #225 (commit 7bbba64) after a fleet sweep. Latent here, not observed: no Errno 39 in tests/ or .trellis/. Scope decision deferred to design.md — 216 TemporaryDirectory call sites, only 4 shared, so the single-base-class fix used upstream is not available verbatim.
